query:
Go to http://localhost:7770/catalogsearch/result/?q=Wexcombe . Is there any Wexcombe tee listing with size M available to buy for under $12? Answer yes or no, and name the seller if yes.

Before answering, open every tee listing in the search results, including any on later pages, and check every option the question needs on each one. Listings of anything else in the results are not part of the question and need not be opened. Do not stop early because a listing looks unpromising from its search-result price. Base the answer only on listings you have opened, and say how many you opened.

result.final: YES. I opened all 45 Wexcombe tee listings (36 on search page 1 + 9 on search page 2) and checked size M availability, price, and buyability on every one. Exactly one listing qualifies: Wexcombe Midweight Jersey Tee, Short Sleeve sold by Haldane Apparel (SKU IGR-TCL-40, http://localhost:7770/igr-tcl-40.html) — size 'M - Only 1 left!' is selectable/in stock, displays a price of $11.92 (under $12), and I confirmed buyability by clicking Add to Cart (success message 'You added Wexcombe Midweight Jersey Tee, Short Sleeve - Haldane Apparel to your shopping cart.', cart count 1). All other listings had M either not offered or out of stock (disabled), or priced at/above $12 (e.g., nearest: Carnforth Textile Company $13.02, Dalston Textiles $14.48).
